notes: Switzerland Hardening I Adoption Gate — border-cash project claims only. Ten distinct claims from thirteen M2.5-reviewed candidates (three public-guidance candidates reconciled into Ordinance-spine claims). Does not draft data/rules/switzerland.json. Art. 6 amount-independent Meldung and Art. 2 definition adopted unbound. No CHF 10,000 declaration threshold or carriage ceiling. No-declaration does not mean no-control.

claims.subject: Unrestricted quantitative carriage of covered cash instruments
claims.rule: Unrestricted amounts of cash — notes and coins, foreign currencies and bearer negotiable instruments (shares, bonds and cheques) — may be carried into, through and out of Switzerland under the FOCBS cross-border cash framework; no quantitative carriage ceiling is established by that framework
claims.scope: FOCBS border-cash framework; inbound, transit and outbound physical carriage of covered instruments; quantitative amount only
claims.authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS / BAZG)
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted from CC-CH-CASH-001; fingerprint sha256:0c8529702aa3d8fe6a3272f606b98dae38021019abcabde574ae93fecdb3faca; FOCBS unrestricted-carriage sentence. Quantitative carriage only.
allowed_wording: into, through and out of Switzerland
forbidden_inferences: Large capital exports by residents are monitored under FINMA

claims.subject: No spontaneous FOCBS cash declaration obligation
claims.rule: Notes and coins, foreign currencies and bearer negotiable instruments (shares, bonds and cheques) carried into, through or out of Switzerland are not obliged to be declared to the Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS)
claims.scope: FOCBS cross-border cash framework; spontaneous traveller declaration to FOCBS; covered instrument categories
claims.authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS / BAZG)
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted from CC-CH-CASH-002 M2.5 reviewed_text; fingerprint sha256:01b17759baf75ddb56af885d696ac998be0e153ca1879be7e2c4a3551ecafcaf. Fresh project judgment: verified (not mechanical map from M2.5 bounded). Stronger than 'no declaration for normal amounts'.
allowed_wording: no obligation to declare this to FOCBS
notes and coins, foreign currencies and bearer negotiable instruments
forbidden_inferences: No general currency declaration is required for normal travel amounts
No mandatory currency declaration threshold applies for ordinary travelers

claims.subject: Truthful information duty when questioned during a FOCBS check
claims.rule: If a person is questioned about cash by FOCBS staff during a check, the person is obliged to report truthful information
claims.scope: FOCBS border check; information-on-request; not spontaneous declaration
claims.authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS / BAZG)
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted from CC-CH-CASH-003; fingerprint sha256:219025c530bcd3ea46fa6799e6b4f25e9220bf388db49765d060f4ffd9390628. Trigger 'during a check' preserved.
allowed_wording: questioned about cash by FOCBS staff during a check
forbidden_inferences: travellers must always proactively provide information
proactive disclosure at the border without questioning
No mandatory currency declaration threshold applies for ordinary travelers

claims.subject: >= CHF 10,000 inquiry / information package on express questioning
claims.rule: In cross-border traffic, the person required to provide information must, upon express questioning by the customs office, provide information as to their person; concerning the import, export and transit of cash amounting to at least CHF 10,000 or the corresponding equivalent in foreign currencies; concerning the origin and the intended use of the cash; and concerning the beneficial owner. FOCBS current public guidance correspondingly states that a person carrying, or suspected of carrying, CHF 10,000 or more will be asked to disclose identity, source, intended use and beneficial owner
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 3 Abs. 1 express-questioning package; FOCBS operational corroboration; operator >= / mindestens CHF 10,000; Ein-/Aus-/Durchfuhr
claims.authority: SR 631.052 Art. 3 Abs. 1; FOCBS current cash guidance
claims.matching_source_note: Canonical claim from CC-CH-CASH-009 (Art. 3 Abs. 1 German legal spine; fingerprint sha256:aae2efa32c3a0ec07104053736f4b373d338cba7fb9427f8b2e2314153029675) with CC-CH-CASH-004 reconciled as supporting FOCBS guidance (fingerprint sha256:6b161e141f7ce37a94bd062aad20d7f79f87abbe71d245e8016e7e9b1baf3fa2). Operator remains mindestens / CHF 10,000 or more / >=. Not a declaration threshold or carriage ceiling.
forbidden_inferences: cash above CHF 10,000 must be declared
anti-money laundering reporting requirements by financial institutions

claims.subject: >= CHF 10,000 FOCBS information-system entry
claims.rule: If the amount of cash equals or exceeds CHF 10,000, a respective entry is registered in the FOCBS information system
claims.scope: FOCBS public operational registration mechanic; distinct from inquiry package and from Ordinance Art. 6 Meldung
claims.authority: Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (FOCBS / BAZG)
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted from CC-CH-CASH-005; fingerprint sha256:0d44e061695995626b60b700acb25dd26d49414bf2d8aa76b7e49f5f10298ecd. Inquiry ≠ recording. Not statistical recording unless separately established. Distinct from CH-CASH-10 Art. 6 amount-independent Meldung.
allowed_wording: registered in the FOCBS information system
forbidden_inferences: anti-money laundering reporting requirements by financial institutions

claims.subject: Below-threshold suspicion information power (Art. 3 Abs. 2)
claims.rule: Where there is suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, the customs office may also require information if the amount of cash does not reach the threshold of CHF 10,000 or the corresponding equivalent in foreign currencies
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 3 Abs. 2; below CHF 10,000; ML/TF suspicion condition required
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted from CC-CH-CASH-010; fingerprint sha256:7ce5808c0f6fff952d16d2636cde8d1e366bcd056cec68a784eef11c383ba59d. Prevents 'below CHF 10,000 = outside FOCBS information controls'.
allowed_wording: suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing
forbidden_inferences: FOCBS can question anyone for any reason

claims.subject: Provisional / temporary seizure on ML/TF suspicion
claims.rule: The customs office may provisionally seize cash pursuant to Article 104 of the Customs Act (ZG); provisional seizure is permissible independent of the amount of cash. FOCBS current guidance states that if there is suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing, the cash may be seized temporarily and handed over to the police
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 4 provisional seizure (amount-independent) with FOCBS temporary-seizure and police-handover operational corroboration; ML/TF suspicion context
claims.authority: SR 631.052 Art. 4; FOCBS current cash guidance
claims.matching_source_note: Canonical claim from CC-CH-CASH-011 (Art. 4; fingerprint sha256:e299b32dee366f3cf52463517b90904d88e4083c0a712a3e789efeb9c37200b3) with CC-CH-CASH-007 reconciled as FOCBS guidance (fingerprint sha256:a555cf296ea5747b05a242fbbe01fece080d1582ed9316b072621ccdfe643895). Temporary/provisional only; not threshold-triggered.
allowed_wording: suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing

claims.subject: Refusal / false information offence (Art. 5 lit. a–b)
claims.rule: Refused or false provision of information under Article 3 paragraph 1 letters a and b constitutes an administrative offence (Ordnungswidrigkeit) within the meaning of Article 127 paragraph 1 of the Customs Act (ZG). FOCBS public guidance correspondingly states that refusal to provide information or giving false information constitutes a customs offence and may result in a penalty
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 5 limited to Art. 3 Abs. 1 lit. a–b (person; Ein-/Aus-/Durchfuhr of Barmittel at/above threshold); FOCBS public corroboration
claims.authority: SR 631.052 Art. 5; FOCBS current cash guidance
claims.matching_source_note: Canonical claim from CC-CH-CASH-012 (Art. 5 lit. a–b; fingerprint sha256:09b56a64ccf199c3ec1bb6c076f38e7313e57b54b87cad98a398fdc6b598adf3) with CC-CH-CASH-006 reconciled as FOCBS guidance (fingerprint sha256:a0e3130d0b208ea386efce9f962149171d79b482fa22e668f83a42c12a39f0f2). Does not broaden beyond lit. a–b.
allowed_wording: refused or false provision of information
Article 3 paragraph 1 letters a and b
forbidden_inferences: all failure to comply with Swiss cash controls is an offence
Art. 5 covers lit. c and d

claims.subject: Legal definition of Barmittel (Art. 2)
claims.rule: For the purposes of SR 631.052, Barmittel means cash money (Swiss and foreign banknotes and coins that are in circulation as means of payment) and transferable bearer instruments, shares, bonds, cheques and similar securities
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 2 lit. b definition; category fidelity guardrail; not a public traveler recital requirement
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted unbound from CC-CH-CASH-008; fingerprint sha256:929b860bbd566b2baf564f2b2f2ebba1ed3f0ac31cef1d4bc7701d8006fae4c2. German legal definition controls; English rule is faithful rendering for project matrix only, not an official English instrument. Preserves 'ähnliche Wertpapiere' / similar securities.
forbidden_inferences: every negotiable instrument equals ordinary cash without distinction
unofficial English Fedlex text is authoritative
collapse ordinance definition into FOCBS shorthand only

claims.subject: Amount-independent customs Meldung permission (Art. 6 Abs. 2)
claims.rule: Die Meldung ist unabhängig vom Betrag der Barmittel zulässig
claims.scope: Ordinance Art. 6 Abs. 2; authority-to-authority reporting permission; amount-independent; not traveller spontaneous declaration
claims.matching_source_note: Adopted unbound from CC-CH-CASH-013 M2.5 reviewed_text; fingerprint sha256:05356f7b613c0d703e4aa2365f914fb073efcda1ee3e16dec566ac5d918d31e3. Fresh project judgment: bounded + unbound. German operative wording retained. Distinct from FOCBS public >=CHF10k information-system entry (CH-CASH-05). Must not be drafted as traveller declaration.
allowed_wording: Die Meldung ist unabhängig vom Betrag der Barmittel zulässig
forbidden_inferences: traveller must declare regardless of amount
Meldung is made by the traveller
